newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnia Feb retail prices up 1.0 pct m/m, 11.4 y/y.
newsitem.headline: Bosnia Feb retail prices up 1.0 pct m/m, 11.4 y/y.

text.p: The Statistics Bureau of Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation issued the following economic indicator details on Monday.
BOSNIA RETAIL PRICES FEB JAN FEB 96

NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of Bosnia-Hercegovina territory. Data for the Bosnian Serb republic are not available. Retail prices in Jan-Feb 1997 rose by 10.4 percent compared to the same period in 1996, the office said. -- Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
